top_jobs.job: When a best seller is on track to run out before a peak or a promo, help me see it while there is still time to order and know how many to buy, so I never lose the biggest sales weeks
top_jobs.metric: days of stock left against supplier lead time plus buffer, for the top 20 products by gross profit

top_jobs.job: When the bank is low and the warehouse is full, help me find the cash stuck in stock that does not sell and turn it back into money, so I can pay for ads and the products that sell
top_jobs.metric: value of stock with no sale in 180 days, at landed cost, monthly

top_jobs.job: When freight, duty, raw material or a supplier moves, help me know what each unit really costs to land and which suppliers are slipping, so I reprice or renegotiate before the next order
top_jobs.metric: landed cost per unit against the cost used in the margin plan, per purchase order

top_jobs.job: When parcels arrive late, damaged or go back, help me see which carrier, region or warehouse fails and what it costs, so I set a promise I can keep and stop paying for their mistakes
top_jobs.metric: on time share and cost per delivered parcel, by carrier and region, 30 day

jobs.job: Compute days of stock left for every product and size against supplier lead time plus a 2 week buffer, and list what must be ordered this week, ranked by gross profit at risk

inputs.need: stock on hand by variant and location
stock at a 3PL or warehouse system, if used
lead time and minimum order per supplier
open purchase orders with landing dates

steps: Pull stock on hand and on order per variant
Compute sales per day from the last 28 and 90 days, and use the higher rate for best sellers
Days left = stock plus orders that land in time, divided by sales per day
Flag variants where days left is under lead time plus 14 days
Rank by gross profit per day that would be lost, and a person checks the top 10 against the shelf
jobs.output: a weekly order list: variant, days left, lead time, and profit at risk
jobs.next: feeds 19-02 (order size) and 21-03 (cash test for the order)

watch.metric: top 20 products by gross profit with days of stock under lead time plus buffer
watch.source: Shopify inventory and purchase order records

jobs.job: Size each reorder: forecast sales over lead time plus the cover target, subtract stock and open orders, round to the minimum order and case pack, and show the cash it needs and when

inputs.need: peaks and promos in the next 16 weeks
minimum order, case pack, price breaks and payment terms

steps: Forecast weekly sales for lead time plus 8 weeks, lifted for known peaks and promos
Subtract stock on hand and open orders, and round up to the minimum order and case pack
Check the next price break: is ordering more cheaper per unit and still safe for cash
Show deposit and balance dates and amounts
Founder approves or changes the number, and the order is logged in the purchase order ledger
jobs.output: a draft purchase order per product with units, cost and payment dates, approved by the founder

watch.metric: products below their reorder point with no open purchase order
watch.source: Shopify inventory and purchase order records

jobs.job: Build the Black Friday stock plan 12 weeks out: target units per top product from last year's peak weeks, this year's growth and planned promos, the gap to stock and open orders, and the last safe order date per supplier

inputs.need: last year's orders by week and variant
peak dates and when prep starts
3PL and carrier cut-off dates and peak capacity

steps: Take last year's 6 peak weeks by variant and adjust for this year's growth rate
Add the lift from each planned promo, based on the last 3 promos
Subtract stock and open orders to get the gap per product
Work back the last safe order date from each supplier's lead time
Ask the 3PL and carriers for peak cut-offs and capacity, and log them
Founder signs the plan and the buys
jobs.output: a peak plan: target, gap and last order date per top product, plus 3PL cut-offs

watch.metric: top products with stock on hand against the peak target

jobs.job: List every ad and shopping product spending on a product with under 14 days of stock, and send the list to the ads team to move budget before the spend runs

inputs.need: ads with landing page and 7 day spend
which page and product id each product uses

steps: Map each ad's landing page or product id to a product
Join the last 7 days of spend to days of stock left
List ads on products under 14 days of stock, with spend and days left
Suggest the in-stock product each ad could point to instead
Send to the ads owner; the person changes the account, ecomOS does not
jobs.output: a twice weekly list of ads on low stock, with spend and a swap

watch.metric: ad spend on products with under 14 days of stock
watch.source: Meta Ads, Google Ads and Shopify inventory

jobs.job: Split stock cover between our warehouse and Amazon, list products where one side runs dry in under 21 days while the other has spare, and say how many units to move and by when
jobs.trigger: every Monday, for sellers on Amazon

inputs.need: Amazon stock, inbound units and sales
transit days from our warehouse to Amazon

steps: Compute days of cover per product on each channel from its own sales rate
Flag products under 21 days on one channel and over 60 days on the other
Units to move = sales per day times 45 days, capped by the spare and by Amazon's limit
Draft the inbound shipment, and a person books it
jobs.output: a transfer list: product, units, from, to, and ship-by date

watch.metric: stock cover in days per product, by channel
watch.source: Shopify inventory and Amazon Seller Central

jobs.drives: Amazon rank and sales lost to stockouts

jobs.job: List every product with no sale in 180 days or over 120 days of cover, value it at landed cost, and show the total cash stuck on one line

inputs.need: stock and last sale date per variant

steps: Pull stock and the last sale date per variant
Mark variants with no sale in 180 days, and those with over 120 days of cover
Value each at landed cost, and add storage cost per month
Total the cash stuck, split by product line
Founder marks which are discontinued, seasonal, or held on purpose
jobs.output: a dead stock list with value, storage cost and a founder mark

watch.metric: value of stock with no sale in 180 days, at landed cost
watch.source: Shopify inventory and purchase order records

jobs.drives: cash free for ads and best sellers

jobs.job: Pick a clearance route for each dead product: bundle with a best seller, VIP-only offer, outlet price, liquidator quote or donation, with the cash each returns against landed cost

inputs.need: margin per best seller for bundles

steps: For each product, estimate units that would sell in 60 days on each route
Compute cash back after fees and shipping for each route
Drop routes the brand rules do not allow
Founder picks one route per product
Set a 60 day check on units cleared and cash back
jobs.output: a clearance plan per product with route, cash back and a check date

watch.metric: cash recovered from cleared stock against landed cost

jobs.job: Count returned units waiting at the warehouse, how long they have waited and how many are sellable, set a 5 day restock rule, and cut reorders that returns already cover
steps: Pull returns received and their restock status
Compute days from received to back in stock, per product
Count the share graded sellable, and the reasons for the rest
Agree a 5 day restock rule with the warehouse
Take returned sellable units off this week's reorder list
jobs.output: a returns backlog table and a trimmed reorder list

watch.metric: days from return received to back in stock

jobs.drives: units bought that we already own

jobs.job: Compare storage cost with gross profit per product at the 3PL and at Amazon over 90 days, and list products that cost more to store than they earn, plus Amazon units close to the aged stock fee
jobs.trigger: monthly, and 60 days before Amazon's aged stock dates

inputs.need: Amazon storage and stock age reports

steps: Split storage cost per product by the space it uses
Set it against 90 day gross profit
List products where storage is over 25 percent of gross profit
List Amazon units over 150 days old
Draft a move, removal or price cut for each, and the founder picks
jobs.output: a storage table and one action per product

watch.metric: storage cost against gross profit per product

jobs.job: Build landed cost for every purchase order: unit price, freight, duty, insurance, packaging and inbound handling split per unit, and flag any product 5 percent above the cost in the margin plan
jobs.trigger: when each order lands, and once for the last 12 months

inputs.from: Shopify cost field and finance shelf

steps: Enter each order with units and unit price
Add freight, duty, insurance and inbound bills; split freight per unit by volume and duty by value
Compare with the cost in the store and in the margin plan
Flag products 5 percent or more above plan, and a person approves the new cost in the store
Recompute gross margin per product at the new cost
jobs.output: a landed cost table per order and product, with updated margins and flags

watch.metric: landed cost per unit against the margin plan
watch.source: purchase order records and Shopify cost field

jobs.job: When a duty rate changes, recompute landed cost and margin per product at the new rate, list products that fall under the margin floor, and lay out reprice, absorb or move options
jobs.trigger: when a tariff change is announced

inputs.need: tariff code and country of origin per product

inputs.from: public tariff schedule, typed into a sheet

inputs.need: how sales moved after past price changes

steps: Recompute duty per unit at the new rate
Compute the new gross margin per product against the floor
For each product under the floor, show the price needed to hold margin and the sales lost at past price response
Add the option to move production, with lead time and cost from the supply shelf
Founder picks one option per product
jobs.output: a table: product, old and new margin, price needed, and the founder's choice

watch.metric: gross margin per unit at the new duty rate

jobs.job: Log the price of the main raw material (such as cotton) every month next to the price last agreed with the supplier, and draft a cost-down ask when it falls 10 percent

inputs.need: the 1 or 2 materials that drive each top product's cost
a public price index for each material
inputs.from: a monthly entry in a sheet

inputs.need: last agreed price and its date
supplier contract and price lock dates

steps: Name the 1 or 2 materials that drive each top product's cost
Log the index each month since the last price was agreed
Compute the change since then
When it falls 10 percent or more, draft a cost-down letter with the numbers
When it rises 10 percent or more, tell finance the likely new price and when it lands
jobs.output: a monthly input cost line per top product, and a draft letter when it moves

watch.metric: input cost index against the price when cost was last agreed
watch.source: public index logged in the brain

jobs.job: Match every supplier invoice to its purchase order and the units received before paying, and list mismatches by count and value
steps: Line up ordered units and price, received units, and invoiced units and price
Flag any line that differs by 1 unit or 1 percent
Hold payment on flagged lines and draft the note to the supplier
Log the outcome and the value saved
jobs.output: a match table per invoice, with holds and notes
jobs.next: feeds 19-14 (supplier score) and 21-04 (which bills to pay)

watch.metric: purchase orders where invoice, order and goods do not match, by value

jobs.drives: cash paid for stock that never came

jobs.job: Score each supplier over 90 days on on-time delivery, defects found at receiving and price drift, and list products that depend on one supplier or one country with no backup
jobs.trigger: each quarter, and when a supplier is late again

inputs.need: promised and actual arrival dates per order

steps: For each supplier, compute on-time share, defect rate and price change per unit
Mark suppliers getting worse over their last 3 orders
Compute each supplier's and country's share of units bought in 12 months
List top products with over 50 percent from one source and no vetted backup
Founder picks 1 product to get a second quote for this quarter
jobs.output: a supplier scorecard and a single-source risk list

watch.metric: supplier on-time delivery and defect rate per order

jobs.job: Book a third party inspection before paying the balance on any new supplier or any order over $20,000, with a checklist built from past defect tickets and return reasons
jobs.trigger: when a factory says an order is ready to ship

inputs.need: top defect reasons for the product over 12 months
an inspection service, about $300 a visit

steps: Pull the top defect reasons for the product over 12 months
Turn them into a checklist with photos of good and bad units
Book the inspection 5 days before the ship date
Read the report: pass, fix and re-inspect, or refuse
Pay the balance only on a pass, and log the result on the supplier score
jobs.output: an inspection checklist, the report, and a pay or hold decision

watch.metric: defect rate found at receiving, per purchase order

jobs.job: Build the carrier scorecard for the last 30 days: on-time share, first attempt delivery, damage and loss, and cost per delivered parcel by carrier and region, and name the worst lane with a cheaper option
jobs.trigger: monthly, and when failed deliveries jump in a region
steps: Join each order's tracking scans to its region and carrier
Compute on-time share against the date shown, first attempt success, and damage or loss rate
Divide the carrier bill by delivered parcels for each lane
Name the worst lane on cost and on service
Price the same lane with 2 other carriers, and draft the switch for the founder
jobs.output: a carrier by region table, and a switch proposal for the worst lane

watch.metric: cost per delivered parcel and on-time share, by carrier and region

jobs.drives: shipping cost per order, and delivery tickets

jobs.job: Set the delivery date shown on product and checkout pages from real door to door times, the 90th percentile by region and carrier, not the carrier's brochure

inputs.from: Shopify fulfilment and the tracking app

steps: Compute median and 90th percentile days from order to delivery by region and carrier
Compare them with the date shown on the site today
Draft the new promise per region, and a person updates the page and checkout
Watch order status tickets and conversion for 4 weeks
jobs.output: a delivery promise per region, live on the site, with a before and after

watch.metric: share of orders delivered by the date shown to the buyer
watch.source: Shopify fulfilment and the tracking app

jobs.job: Check each carrier invoice against the expected charge from shipped weight, box size and zone, list overcharges, surcharges and late delivery refunds owed, and file the claims
jobs.trigger: monthly, when the carrier invoice arrives

inputs.need: shipped weight and box size per order

steps: Compute the expected charge per parcel from the rate card
Flag parcels billed 5 percent or more over the expected charge
Add lost and damaged parcels not yet claimed
Draft claims with order numbers and proof, and a person files them
Log money recovered each month
jobs.output: a claim file per carrier and a monthly recovered total

watch.metric: carrier invoice amount against expected charge

jobs.job: Measure the warehouse's real dispatch time against the contract, from order to label to first carrier scan, and send them a monthly scorecard with pick errors from tickets
jobs.trigger: weekly, with a scorecard each month

inputs.need: order time, label time and first scan
inputs.from: Shopify fulfilment and the tracking app

inputs.need: wrong item and missing item tickets

steps: Compute hours from order to label and to first scan, per day
Compute the share shipped within the promised time, and the worst days
Count wrong item and missing item tickets per 1,000 orders
Send the warehouse a 1 page scorecard with the numbers and any credits owed under the contract
jobs.output: a monthly warehouse scorecard and a credit request

watch.metric: share of orders shipped within the promised dispatch time
watch.source: Shopify fulfilment and the tracking app

jobs.job: List delivery exceptions every morning (wrong address, failed attempt, held at depot) with the hours left to act, and have a person contact each customer the same day
steps: Pull open exceptions and the hours left before the parcel goes back
Sort by hours left and order value
Text or email each customer with the step they need to take
A person updates the carrier and logs the outcome
jobs.output: a daily exception list with each one closed or returned

watch.metric: open delivery exceptions with under 24 hours left to act

jobs.drives: return to sender cost and lost customers

new_enablers.name: Stock cover and reorder engine
new_enablers.what: Days of stock left per product, size and location (own warehouse, 3PL, Amazon) at the current sales rate, against supplier lead time plus a buffer. Sets reorder points and order sizes rounded to minimum order and case pack, plans peaks, and flags ads running on low stock and stock that does not sell.
inputs: lead time and minimum order per supplier
powers: what to order this week and how much
ad spend on products about to run out
stock split between site and Amazon

new_enablers.name: Purchase order and landed cost ledger
new_enablers.what: Every purchase order with dates, units, unit price, freight, duty, packaging and inbound cost split per unit, units received, defects found and invoice match. Scores each supplier on time, defects and price drift, and holds the payment dates.
powers: true cost per unit and margins that broke
cash out dates for the forecast

new_enablers.name: Carrier and warehouse scorecard
new_enablers.what: Per carrier, region and warehouse: time from order to dispatch to delivery, first attempt success, damage and loss, cost per delivered parcel, and billed against expected charges. Open exceptions with the hours left to act.
powers: a delivery promise we can keep
